title: Policies for information security
justification: Top-level policy and nine topic policies set the rules every team works to; clients ask for them in due diligence

title: Information security roles and responsibilities
justification: Named owners for the ISMS, risks, assets and controls are needed to make anything happen

title: Segregation of duties
justification: Supplier set-up, payment release and refunds are split between finance roles in the ERP

title: Management responsibilities
justification: Line managers enforce policy, approve access and complete leaver steps for their teams

title: Contact with authorities
justification: Breach and cyber-incident notifications must reach the right UAE authority quickly

title: Contact with special interest groups
justification: Membership of a regional logistics security forum and vendor advisories keep the team informed

title: Threat intelligence
justification: Managed SOC feeds and sector advisories are consumed; a formal monthly threat summary is not yet produced

title: Information security in project management
justification: Portal, WMS and OT projects change the risk picture and pass a security checkpoint at design

title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
justification: Asset register exists for IT; OT inventory still incomplete

title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
justification: Acceptable use rules exist; the approved cloud and AI tools list is not yet enforced

title: Return of assets
justification: Laptops, phones, scanners and badges must come back from leavers and contractors

title: Classification of information
justification: Four-level scheme lets staff tell consignee and payroll data apart from public material

title: Labelling of information
justification: Sensitivity labels in Microsoft 365 carry the classification and drive DLP

title: Information transfer
justification: Manifests and customer files are exchanged daily with clients, carriers and customs brokers

title: Access control
justification: Role-based access across Microsoft 365, WMS, portal and ERP is the core preventive control

title: Identity management
justification: Every user, scanner and service identity must be unique; shared scanner logins remain in Dubai

title: Authentication information
justification: Passwords, keys and MFA methods are issued and protected under one standard

title: Access rights
justification: Joiner-mover-leaver process exists but leaver timing failed audit sampling

title: Information security in supplier relationships
justification: Over 60 suppliers and carriers touch Northwind data or systems

title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
justification: Security, breach-notification and audit clauses are in the standard contract template

title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
justification: Cloud, SaaS and OT vendors bring their own sub-suppliers into the chain

title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
justification: Critical suppliers are reviewed yearly and on contract change

title: Information security for use of cloud services
justification: Microsoft 365, Azure and four SaaS services carry most of the in-scope information

title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
justification: Clients expect 24-hour notification; playbooks are still being tested

title: Assessment and decision on information security events
justification: Managed SOC triage criteria decide what becomes an incident

title: Response to information security incidents
justification: Response steps exist; two of four playbooks still to be exercised

title: Learning from information security incidents
justification: Post-incident reviews are done for major incidents but not yet tracked to closure

title: Collection of evidence
justification: Evidence may be needed for police, insurers or disciplinary cases

title: Information security during disruption
justification: Security controls must stay in place when running on manual or DR arrangements

title: ICT readiness for business continuity
justification: WMS RTO of 8 hours is a client commitment; DR test overdue

title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
justification: Register of obligations covers PDPL, IA Regulation alignment, customs and client contracts

title: Intellectual property rights
justification: Software licences and portal third-party components must be used lawfully

title: Protection of records
justification: Customs declarations, invoices and HR records have legal retention periods

title: Privacy and protection of PII
justification: Consignee and employee personal data are processed at scale under the UAE PDPL

title: Independent review of information security
justification: Internal audit by a trained auditor independent of IT, plus annual external penetration test

title: Compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security
justification: Managers and the ISM check policy compliance; results feed the management review

title: Documented operating procedures
justification: Critical IT procedures exist; WMS integration runbooks are still being written

title: Screening
justification: Background checks are required for staff working on the port operator's sites and for IT admins

title: Terms and conditions of employment
justification: Employment contracts include confidentiality and acceptable-use duties

title: Information security awareness, education and training
justification: Office staff trained; warehouse shift completion below target

title: Disciplinary process
justification: A fair, documented process is needed when policy breaches are confirmed

title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
justification: Confidentiality duties continue after exit; leaver access removal is late

title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
justification: NDAs are signed by contractors, carriers and suppliers with data access

title: Remote working
justification: Office staff work up to two days a week from home on managed laptops

title: Information security event reporting
justification: Report-phishing button and a single security mailbox are available to all staff

title: Physical security perimeters
justification: Four sites hold goods, IT equipment and a server room

title: Physical entry
justification: Badge control, visitor log and escort rules at all sites

title: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
justification: The Dubai server room and Abu Dhabi comms room need stronger protection than open offices

title: Physical security monitoring
justification: CCTV covers perimeters, docks and the server room

title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
justification: Fire suppression, flood sensors and heat monitoring protect the server room

title: Working in secure areas
justification: Rules for contractors working in the server room and on the port operator's premises

title: Clear desk and clear screen
justification: Shipping documents with personal data lie on desks and dock tables

title: Equipment siting and protection
justification: Edge servers and OT controllers are racked and protected from dust and forklifts

title: Security of assets off-premises
justification: Laptops and driver phones leave the premises every day

title: Storage media
justification: USB storage is blocked by default; approved encrypted drives only

title: Supporting utilities
justification: UPS and generator keep the server room and conveyors running

title: Cabling security
justification: Warehouse cabling runs near loading equipment and needs protection

title: Equipment maintenance
justification: Server room, UPS and conveyor controllers are on maintenance contracts

title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
justification: Laptops, phones and scanners are wiped or destroyed with certificates

title: User endpoint devices
justification: Laptops, phones and scanners all process company data

title: Privileged access rights
justification: Admin roles in Entra ID, Azure, WMS and ERP are the highest-impact access

title: Information access restriction
justification: Portal customers must only see their own shipments; SharePoint sites are permissioned by team

title: Access to source code
justification: Portal source code is developed in-house; pipeline secrets migration in progress

title: Secure authentication
justification: MFA everywhere; phishing-resistant MFA for admins and finance

title: Capacity management
justification: WMS and portal load triples in the November to January peak

title: Protection against malware
justification: EDR on all endpoints and servers; email and file scanning in Microsoft 365

title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
justification: Monthly patching with 14-day target for critical internet-facing flaws

title: Configuration management
justification: Baselines for Windows, Azure resources and firewalls are kept as code or exported monthly

title: Information deletion
justification: Personal data must be deleted when retention periods end

title: Data masking
justification: Portal test data should be masked; currently copies of production are restricted instead

title: Data leakage prevention
justification: DLP policies watch consignee and payroll data in Microsoft 365

title: Information backup
justification: Immutable backups in place; restore testing not performed as planned

title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
justification: WMS has a secondary Azure region configured but failover is untested

title: Logging
justification: Logs are needed for detection and evidence; portal retention below standard

title: Monitoring activities
justification: Managed SOC monitors Microsoft 365 and endpoints; portal and WMS coverage in progress

title: Clock synchronization
justification: Cloud services and on-site devices use common time sources so events can be correlated

title: Use of privileged utility programs
justification: Admin tools are limited to privileged access workstations

title: Installation of software on operational systems
justification: Endpoints controlled; HMI allowlisting planned

title: Networks security
justification: Firewalls protect sites and Azure; OT boundary still being built

title: Security of network services
justification: Internet links and SD-WAN service have security and availability terms

title: Segregation of networks
justification: Corporate, guest, scanner and OT networks must be separated

title: Web filtering
justification: Malicious and unsanctioned sites must be blocked; app blocking still planned

title: Use of cryptography
justification: TLS, disk encryption and Key Vault-managed keys protect data and payment integration

title: Secure development life cycle
justification: In-house portal development; security testing being added to the pipeline

title: Application security requirements
justification: Portal and payment features carry security requirements in each user story

title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
justification: Portal and integrations follow documented architecture principles

title: Secure coding
justification: Coding standard exists; SAST and dependency scanning still being rolled out

title: Security testing in development and acceptance
justification: Annual pentest done; DAST in the pipeline still being added

title: Outsourced development
justification: Excluded: all portal and integration development is done by Northwind employees; WMS is configured, not developed, by the vendor. Revisit if any development is contracted out

title: Separation of development, test and production environments
justification: Portal has separate dev, test and production subscriptions

title: Change management
justification: Change advisory board for production; pipeline approvals being tightened

title: Test information
justification: Test databases must not hold live consignee data without protection

title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
justification: Penetration tests and audit queries are scheduled outside peak hours with rollback plans
